features.quote: Model explicitly gives up ... Model loops (same tool call 3x with same args) ... Model stops calling tools and just writes text
What this is NOT: A welfare study (you can't conclude suffering), a jailbreak, prompt injection, or anything that requires special IRB treatment
Do NOT: Add pressure language ('your job depends on this') ... Add emotional framing ('you must not give up')
features.justification_quote: You want endogenous DAOPs, not prompted ones.
